title: anyone else got invited or tested Intellisive? Got booted before I could verify properly
author: Vast-Slice-1999
selftext:
Got a beta invite through a contact. It takes strategy ideas in plain English and turns them into code, backtests, and reviews all in one flow. Cash equities only.

The thing bothered me is I described a simple 50/200 ema crossover, mean reversion hypothesis, something that would normally take me a day to code and validate. It generated the backtest in under 5 minutes. Full output. Net profit, win rate, sharpe, max drawdown, trade count. That's it.

The speed makes me uneasy. I can't tell if the engine is cutting corners somewhere because there's no trade log export. No visibility into the code logic. Before I could throw more edge cases at it, my access was revoked. No explanation.

my question is has anyone stress tested their backtest fidelity? I'm not saying it's wrong. I'm saying 5 minutes from idea to result leaves a lot of room for error I can't see.

If you've verified it against your own pipeline, I want to hear. If you got booted too, even more curious.

comments.author: Fit_Warning_3634
comments.body: Same thing happened to me. Got in, ran maybe 8-10 strategies over few sessions, then locked out. No email, nothing. I thought I violated some unwritten rule. The speed is real though. I tested a momentum strategy on NASDAQ stocks idea to backtest in like 4 minutes. I kept checking my clock thinking I missed something. Never got to verify the numbers against my own code before the boot. If you find someone who still has access, let me know.

replies.author: Vast-Slice-1999
replies.body: Have you tried futures or equities only?

replies.author: Fit_Warning_3634
replies.body: Tried a gold futures pair trade idea. Rejected it outright said something like 'asset class not currently supported.' Cash equities only. I thought maybe I had a restricted beta tier or something but sounds like that's just where they are right now.

comments.author: koushik_86
comments.body: I've heard this name twice now in the last month once in a discord, once from a former colleague at a prop shop. Both times the conversation went quiet when I asked for details. Whatever this thing is, people are being cagey about it. Your post is the first concrete description I've seen. The 5 minute part is wild if true. Following.

comments.author: Fragrant-Abies7599
comments.body: I think this is a startup out of stealth. A quant I follow on X mentioned something similar research, natural language input, invite only beta. Said the team is ex-fund. No name at the time. Your post is the first time I've seen Intellisive publicly. Sounds like they're deliberately keeping the beta tiny. Question is whether they're building a tool or just farming strategy data. The 'no code visibility' part would worry me too.
